metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.program: Mississippi State Department of Health (MSDH) — Genetics Program — Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: Mississippi has NO public downloadable opt-out form. Under MS Code — 41-21-201 and 41-21-203, newborn screening is mandatory; refusal on religious grounds requires a signed refusal form (Appendix B of the MSDH Newborn Screening Guide). The form is obtained from the birthing facility or MSDH Genetics Program. The signed refusal is placed in the infant's medical record and a copy sent to MSDH Newborn Screening Program.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Collect blood spot per protocol; if parent declines on religious grounds, ensure signed refusal form (Appendix B) is in the infant's medical record and a copy sent to MSDH Genetics Program. Homebirth midwife marks 'Home Birth' on the DBS card and provides midwife contact info.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening (EHDI)
hearing_screening.program: Mississippi State Department of Health (MSDH) Genetics Program
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Same religious exemption as metabolic screening; refusal documented in medical record per MS Code 41-21-201/41-21-203. No separate state form for hearing.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Perform or arrange newborn hearing screen; if out-of-hospital birth, coordinate with regional audiology for follow-up. Document refusal in medical record if applicable. Hearing screening data entered on the DBS card (Section: Hearing Screening).

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.program: Mississippi State Department of Health (MSDH) Genetics Program
cchd_screening.state_form_note: Same religious exemption as metabolic screening; refusal documented in medical record. No separate state CCHD declination form.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse oximetry screening; if out-of-hospital birth, coordinate with receiving facility or regional provider for CCHD screen before discharge. CCHD data entered on the DBS card.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.program: Mississippi law — not part of the NBS program
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: No standalone state declination form for eye prophylaxis; documented via medical record refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If declining: document refusal in medical record. If administering: apply ophthalmic prophylaxis within 1â2 hours of birth per standard protocol.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in medical record; midwife administers injection if chosen.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.program: Mississippi State Department of Health — Immunization Program
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; report to the Mississippi Immunization Registry (MIR).

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal/intrapartum)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; GBS swab in late pregnancy; intrapartum antibiotics arranged via referral or in-office for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
